summary: Completed testing of WatchNexus IPTV (Relish) and Pulp (Usenet) APIs. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend VideoPlayer has subtitle menu with Garnish branding. Watch Party page integrates with Marmalade video streaming when media_id is present.

issues: IPTV tab shows 'Coming Soon' placeholder - frontend UI for IPTV management not fully implemented yet, but backend APIs are working

action_items: Consider implementing frontend UI for IPTV source management (add M3U sources, view channels) - backend APIs are ready
critical_code_review_comments: VideoPlayer component has subtitle button with 'Subtitles (Garnish 🌿)' branding at line 582
Watch Party page connects to Marmalade stream when media_id is present (line 356)
All IPTV/Pulp endpoints require authentication - properly secured
seed_data_creation: None - IPTV starts with 0 sources/channels as expected
context_for_next_testing_agent: IPTV (Relish) and Pulp (Usenet) backend APIs are fully functional. Frontend Live TV page shows 'Coming Soon' placeholder but backend is ready. VideoPlayer has Garnish subtitle integration. Watch Party connects to Marmalade streams.

GET /api/iptv/stats.details: Returns statistics with total_sources, total_channels, total_groups, favorites_count, hidden_count, online_count, offline_count, unchecked_count, epg_channels, total_programs

GET /api/iptv/sources.details: Returns empty list initially (no M3U sources added)

POST /api/iptv/sources.details: Successfully adds IPTV source with name, url, epg_url

GET /api/iptv/channels.details: Returns empty list initially, supports filters (favorites_only, search, group)

POST /api/iptv/parse-m3u.details: Successfully parses M3U content and returns channel list with id, name, stream_url, group

GET /api/iptv/export.details: Exports channels as M3U file with filename 'watchnexus_iptv.m3u'

GET /api/pulp/queue.details: Returns queue as list of NZB items

POST /api/pulp/queue.details: Adds NZB to queue, returns id and status

auth_required.details: All IPTV and Pulp endpoints return 401/403 without authentication

video_player_subtitles.details: VideoPlayer has subtitle button (data-testid='subtitles-btn') and menu (data-testid='subtitle-menu') with 'Subtitles (Garnish 🌿)' branding

watch_party_video.details: Watch Party page connects to Marmalade stream URL when party.media_id is present

frontend_live_tv.details: Live TV page shows 'Coming Soon' with tabs (Channels, Guide, Recordings, IPTV) - backend ready but frontend UI not fully implemented
